title: Controlled 140 GHz specular reflection geometry and composition derivation
purpose: Audit-only equations and numerical fixtures. This file is not a runtime evaluator and contains no production reflection implementation.

references.name: ITU-R P.2040-4
references.use: complex interface/slab coefficients and TE/TM conventions

references.name: ITU-R P.1410-4
references.use: official single-bounce urban reflection and separate diffuse-scatter analogue

geometry_derivation.coordinate_system: local ENU metres; facade is a vertical plane
geometry_derivation.plane: n·(x-p0)=0, with unit normal n and a point p0 on the facade
validity_gates: n·(Tx-p0) > 0 and n·(Rx-p0) > 0 for the selected exterior side
horizontal S lies within the selected finite edge parameter [0,1]
vertical S lies within [base_z, top_z] with known or explicitly declared bounds
both legs pass independent visibility/obstruction checks
geometry_derivation.angle_invariant: theta_i = acos(|k_i·n|), theta_r = acos(|k_r·n|), and theta_i=theta_r for the image construction

candidate_a_two_fspl.decision: rejected for ideal infinite/large planar specular reflection with dimensionless Gamma
candidate_a_two_fspl.field_power_issue: It applies two independent point-to-point power factors and has no finite-area/RCS normalization; it also duplicates the 4pi/lambda constants.

candidate_b_image_path.decision: selected for the ideal-planar reference branch
candidate_b_image_path.field_form: E_ref proportional to Gamma exp(-j k L)/L

candidate_c_image_source.formula: virtual Tx image and one spherical wave over L=|Tx_i-Rx|
candidate_c_image_source.decision: geometry and field representation underlying candidate B
candidate_c_image_source.limitation: finite facade size and edge diffraction are not automatically captured

candidate_d_finite_facet_or_rcs.formula: finite physical-optics, aperture, BRDF, or RCS model with explicit area/shape/statistics
candidate_d_finite_facet_or_rcs.decision: deferred and not interchangeable with candidate B
candidate_d_finite_facet_or_rcs.limitation: requires reflector extent, roughness/correlation, observation geometry, and a sourced model

controlled_difference.interpretation: The two-FSPL result is not a harmless alternative rounding; it is a different physical model and is rejected for the ideal mirror contract.

p2040_composition.field_contract: E_ref = E_propagation(L) * Gamma_{TE/TM} * exp(-j k L) * directional_terms
p2040_composition.once_only_rule: The complex Gamma is applied once in field form, or |Gamma|^2 once in power form. Do not apply a reflection coefficient and then subtract a separate reflection-loss dB term again.
p2040_composition.interface_mode: Use the front-interface coefficient r_TE or r_TM for a declared semi-infinite/opaque surface or when rear-interface coherence cannot be supported.
p2040_composition.slab_mode: Use P.2040 total R_TE or R_TM only with explicit thickness, rear medium, layer stack, phase/coherence, angle and polarization evidence.
p2040_composition.unknown_mode: Return slab_coherence_unknown or interface_only with qualification; never silently choose a slab.
p2040_composition.power_conservation_note: P.2040 reflected/transmitted power accounting requires the appropriate impedance/flux correction; the reflected-path reference uses the reflected field coefficient and does not add slab transmission.

direction_and_polarization.rx_direction: k_arrival = normalize(S-Rx) for the receiver look direction toward the reflector; the propagation direction after reflection is normalize(Rx-S)
direction_and_polarization.antenna_rule: Evaluate Tx and Rx patterns at these reflected directions independently. Direct-path bearing and attenuation must not be reused.
direction_and_polarization.te_basis: s = normalize(cross(n,k_incident)) up to deterministic sign
direction_and_polarization.tm_basis: p = normalize(cross(s,k_incident)) or the equivalent tangential p basis
direction_and_polarization.normal_incidence: The incidence plane is not unique; choose a deterministic projected global ENU basis and note that TE/TM amplitudes are equal at normal incidence.
direction_and_polarization.user_polarization: H/V cannot be mapped directly to TE/TM. Arbitrary polarization needs vector decomposition and transport; first 4I.5B scope should require explicit TE or TM.
direction_and_polarization.existing_4g1_boundary: Current analytic pattern APIs are scalar horizontal/vertical attenuation helpers, not a measured 3D 140 GHz aperture/codebook. A future adapter must preserve true departure/arrival direction.

footprint_edge_does_not_prove: reflecting side in a complex multipart facade
facade_and_visibility.normal_orientation: For local ENU shoelace area A>0 (CCW exterior), outward edge normal is (dy,-dx); for A<0 (CW exterior), outward is (-dy,dx). Validate against an interior point and reject ambiguous rings. Holes are not exterior facade segments; each MultiPolygon component is treated separately.
facade_and_visibility.vertical_point: A vertical plane preserves z during mirroring; S.z is obtained from the 3D intersection and must be inside an evidence-backed base/top interval.
facade_and_visibility.self_obstruction: The reflecting building may be exempted only at the endpoint S. Positive-length penetration behind S, an unrelated edge, or a non-endpoint tangent/grazing contact remains blocking under deterministic conservative rules.
facade_and_visibility.visibility: Check Tx->S and S->Rx separately; do not use direct-path visibility as a substitute.

controlled_fixtures.name: symmetric normal-incidence reflection
controlled_fixtures.inputs: plane x=0, normal +x, Tx=(20,0,5), Rx=(40,0,5), segment y/z includes (0,0,5)
controlled_fixtures.expected: S=(0,0,5), theta_i=theta_r=0°, finite segment and height pass

controlled_fixtures.name: reflection point outside segment
controlled_fixtures.inputs: fixture B with finite segment y∈[1,10]

controlled_fixtures.name: unknown wall height
controlled_fixtures.inputs: fixture B with no trusted/user-declared top_z
controlled_fixtures.expected: unknown; reason vertical_extent_unknown; no fallback height

controlled_fixtures.name: blocked first leg
controlled_fixtures.inputs: fixture B plus an independent opaque obstacle crossing Tx->S at positive distance from S
controlled_fixtures.expected: blocked; reason first_leg_obstructed; reflecting endpoint exemption does not apply to the obstacle

controlled_fixtures.name: blocked second leg
controlled_fixtures.inputs: fixture B plus an independent opaque obstacle crossing S->Rx at positive distance from S

controlled_fixtures.name: zero/near-zero reflection material
controlled_fixtures.expected: Gamma_TE=Gamma_TM=0; reflected power is zero/inapplicable as a useful path

controlled_fixtures.name: high-reflection material
controlled_fixtures.expected: large nonzero TE reflection coefficient; no claim that this is an Ankara facade

hand_checkable_140ghz_example.declaration: Controlled ideal planar facade; not Ankara geometry and not a calibrated material claim.

facade.material_declaration: lossless semi-infinite epsilon_r=4, air on incident side

hand_checkable_140ghz_example.interpretation: This is an isolated reflected-path reference power. It is not direct-plus-reflected total power, not a whole-building loss, and not a validated Ankara result.

fresnel_and_reflector_scale.policy: Use the Fresnel footprint as a qualification/evidence check, not an invented universal minimum facade width or height. A finite-facet model is required when the facade does not cover the relevant zone.

roughness.criterion: g = 4 pi sigma_h/lambda * sin(grazing_angle) = 4 pi sigma_h/lambda * cos(incidence_angle)
required_evidence: RMS height within relevant Fresnel zone
surface correlation length/texture where diffuse partition matters
roughness.unknown_policy: specularity_evidence=unknown and qualified result; never invent an Ankara roughness value

far_field.unknown_aperture: Antenna far-field validity cannot be proven from gain alone; do not manufacture D from gain.
far_field.surface_assumption: The facade must also be locally planar and sufficiently extended for the selected image/GO approximation; curvature and finite aperture are separate evidence gates.

composition.atmosphere: If future input supplies P.676/P.838/P.840 specific losses, integrate leg 1 and leg 2 separately; for homogeneous conditions A_atm_total=A_leg1+A_leg2=gamma_specific*(d1+d2).
composition.p1411: Alternative statistical branch; do not add its median to this path.
composition.p526: Alternative diffraction diagnostic; do not add its loss to this path.
composition.research_sub_thz: Alternative FSPL plus 80 dB/event compatibility branch; do not add it.
composition.coherent_sum: Excluded from first scope. If authorized later, E_total=E_direct+E_reflected requires complex phase, antenna phase, reflection phase, polarization vector, coherence and bandwidth handling.
composition.bandwidth_example: A 1 GHz bandwidth has a free-space coherence-length scale of about c/B=0.3 m; any averaging policy must be explicit.

decision.4i5b_scope: one planar vertical facade, one finite segment, one isolated reflected path, explicit height/material/thickness or interface mode, explicit TE/TM, direction-aware antenna terms, two-leg visibility, no diffuse scattering, no direct-plus-reflected sum, no network coupling
